# `area_kind`

What every area of a kind starts with: tags, variables, clock, priority (02 §8.3).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `tags` (list of string; optional): Tags every area of this kind carries.
- `vars` (object, name → [any JSON value](../values.md#json); optional): Variables every area of this kind starts with: a name and a boolean, a number or a text.
- `clock_rate` (number, or `null`; optional): The rate of the clock areas of this kind run on, relative to their realm's. Absent: they have no clock of their own.
- `priority` (whole number; optional): Which area applies where several overlap: the highest. Default 0.
- `sealed` (`true` or `false`; optional): Whether areas of this kind are sealed volumes with compartments and pressure (11 §10). Stored and reported only.
- `leak` ([any JSON value](../values.md#json), or `null`; optional): How fast a sealed area's held temperature moves toward the outside (11 §4.6). Stored as written.
- `ambience` (string, or `null`; optional): How it looks inside (12 §6.4). Stored as written.
- `rules` (list of [any JSON value](../values.md#json); optional): Rules attached to every area of this kind (05 §9.3): rule ids or inline rules. Carried as written until the rule runtime exists.
